nodes.name: CIP Deliverables
nodes.summary: Corporate Identity Package (CIP) deliverables catalog listing 50 brand identity items across categories: Core Identity, Stationery, Security Access, Office Environment, Apparel, Promotional, Vehicle, Digital, Product, Events, and Documents. Each deliverable includes category, keywords, description, dimensions, file format, logo placement, color usage, typography notes, mockup context, best practices, and common mistakes to avoid.

nodes.name: CIP Industries
nodes.summary: Industry-specific CIP style guide mapping 20 industries to their recommended visual identity systems. Each entry defines the CIP style approach, primary/secondary color palettes, typography choices, key deliverables, mood/atmosphere, best practices, and patterns to avoid for that industry sector.

nodes.name: CIP Mockup Contexts
nodes.summary: Presentation mockup scene definitions for showcasing CIP brand materials. Contains 20 contexts across categories (Stationery, Modern, Premium, Clean, Environment, Vehicle, Events, Digital, Product, Apparel, Catalog) with scene descriptions, lighting conditions, environments, props, camera angles, backgrounds, style notes, and AI prompt modifiers for generating realistic mockups.

edges.description: Deliverables reference mockup contexts for presentation (Mockup Context column in deliverables.csv maps to Context Name in mockup-contexts.csv)
Deliverables are selected based on industry-specific requirements (Key Deliverables column in industries.csv maps to Deliverable names in deliverables.csv)
Industry styles influence mockup context selection for brand-appropriate presentation
